title: Daily digest: Man spits gutka on electrical wire in MP | CID Detains Mulugu District Millers Over | EC refuses to give details of SIR softwa | Brazil votes in tense Lula vs Bolsonaro
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Deccan Chronicle / Times of India / The Hindu
bullets_en: Man spits gutka on electrical wire in MP, dies of burns.
CID Detains Mulugu District Millers Over CMR Irregularities.
EC refuses to give details of SIR software, cites ‘trade secrets, IPR'.
Brazil votes in tense Lula vs Bolsonaro runoff with U.S. influence over Latin America at stake.
bullets_ur: MP mein bijli ki taar par gutka thooknay se shakhs jhulash kar halak

EC ne SIR software ki tafseelaat dene se inkar kar diya, 'trade secrets, IPR' ka hawala diya
Brazil mein Lula aur Bolsonaro ke darmiyan tense runoff vote, Latin America par U.S. ka asar daao par
